metadata.short_desc: Random images, gallery browsing and a visual panel for your img-api image bed.
metadata.desc: Connects to an img-api compatible image bed (docs: https://imgapi.bixygames.com/docs) for random images, gallery listing, image details, stats and avatars. Configure the image bed API URL after installation.

base_url.hint: Blank by default; the plugin will not call any image bed until this is set. Enter your img-api URL, e.g. https://imgapi.bixygames.com; docs: https://imgapi.bixygames.com/docs. Self-hosted instances are supported with http(s)://.

token.hint: Create one in Profile → API Token. Calls default to /api/v1?token=xxx; PNG, origin images, non-public listings and higher rate limits require it.

subtitles: All approved images, usually the largest set
Only images added to the V2 gallery, good for wallpapers
default_gallery.hint: Used by chat commands and when the WebUI first opens.

subtitles: Small and fast, available to guests
Requires a valid token; for clients that only accept PNG
Requires a valid token; unavailable when missing
default_type.hint: Image format used when sending pictures in chat.

subtitles: Match any of the supplied tags
tag_mode.hint: Applies when more than one tag is provided.

subtitles: Requests with the token and sends an image message
The platform downloads the URL without the token; origin falls back
send_mode.hint: Downloading first keeps the token out of public URLs.

allow_origin.hint: When disabled, origin images are unavailable; WebP/PNG are unaffected. Origin requires a token and is larger.

show_meta.hint: Adds gallery, dimensions, tags and image ID before the image message.

request_timeout.hint: Timeout for API calls and image downloads.

retry_times.hint: Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried; 429 rate limits are not.

max_image_mb.hint: Images above this limit are rejected to protect memory and bandwidth.

cooldown_seconds.hint: Minimum interval between two /random commands from the same user in the same session. 0 disables it.

cache_ttl.hint: Caches /stats and /health results to reduce requests. 0 disables caching.

command_page_size.hint: Number of images shown per page by the gallery list command.

webui_page_size.hint: Number of images loaded per page in the gallery panel.

max_tags.hint: Maximum number of tags kept when parsing commands and WebUI input.

subtitles: Safer: the token never appears in the URL
Maximum compatibility, but the token appears in both places
token_mode.hint: Defaults to query. URLs may be recorded by logs or proxies; prefer header when the site supports it.

exclude_tags.hint: Random images containing these tags are skipped. #avatar is excluded by default so profile images are not served as random images. Leave empty to disable.

exclude_retries.hint: How many times to redraw when an excluded tag is hit; a friendly error is returned if every attempt is excluded.

settings.baseUrlHint: No requests are made while this is blank. Enter your img-api URL, e.g. https://imgapi.bixygames.com.

settings.tokenPlaceholderSaved: Saved {token}; leave empty to keep it

about.title: About
about.desc: This plugin uses the public Bixy image bed API for random images, gallery browsing, image details, stats and avatars.
about.f1: Chat commands: /随机图, /图库列表, /图库信息, /图库统计 and more.
about.f2: Supports V1 / V2 galleries, tag filters and WebP / PNG / origin output.
about.f3: The token is only used in server-side request headers and never added to public URLs.
about.f4: Settings are shared with the AstrBot plugin configuration panel.
about.unofficial: This is a community plugin and is not affiliated with the image bed site. Follow the site rules and rate limits.
